channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jalen Suggs | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jalen Suggs from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Nick Nurse, on playing the Magic in the play-in game:

“Physical team. Big wings and aggressive guards. Suggs and Bane are two competitive, physical guys back there... They've been one of many teams in the league that hasn't been very healthy this year, so it's gonna be a tough game.”

Nick Nurse on Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs, Apr 12, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: God Shammgod on Tyus Jones, Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs, Anthony Black
item.description:
“They’re at the right age where they still young, but they, they young enough to dare. Dare to be great. And I, I believe like Paolo and Franz is going to be great, but Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs, Anthony Black, we got Tyus Jones. Now we got, we got so many great players. “And they all right. And I feel like right now they all are ready to make their mark. So I’m just happy and honored to be a part of it.”

God Shammgod on Tyus Jones, Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs, Anthony Black, Sep 2, 2025. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Jalen Suggs
item.description:
Magic veteran swingman Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, who contributed 19 points on seven-of-eight shooting, highlighted the impact of their interior defense.

“It’s kinda hard to score on that when you got me, Suggs, Franz guarding the wings and then if you get past us you got the two big guys down there, shot blockers to change a lot of shots for us,”

Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Jalen Suggs, Nov 30, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Jalen Suggs
item.description:
“Don't be surprised if you see me and [Jalen Suggs] on All-Defensive team next year.”

Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Jalen Suggs, Jul 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Mo Bamba on Wendell Carter, Jalen Suggs
item.description:
“All those guys. I’m probably going to stop by Jalen Suggs’s mom’s house tomorrow (Tuesday) just to kick it or whatever, but that’s family. Cole, Wendell, Kelle, those are guys that I grew up with in the league and this is my first chance to actually play against them. We played them in LA when I was in LA, I was hurt, but it’s gonna be fun.”

Mo Bamba on Wendell Carter, Jalen Suggs, Dec 26, 2023. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jalen Suggs
item.description:
James Edwards III:Casey on Suggs:

“When we interviewed him, he was one of the most impressive young men I've interviewed in 30 years.”

Dwane Casey on Jalen Suggs, Oct 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Scottie Barnes on Jalen Suggs
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Scottie Barnes on first game against Jalen Suggs:

“Me and Suggs are great friends. He's like a brother to me... Of course we'll compete at the highest level. Try to get the best of each other.”

Scottie Barnes on Jalen Suggs, Oct 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.
